text_en: Since the law has only a shadow of the good things to come and not the true form of these realities, it can never, by the same sacrifices that are continually offered year after year, make perfect those who approach.
text_cn: 法律既然只有未来美物的影子，没有那些事物的真相，所以总不能因着每年常献的同样牺牲，使那些愿意亲近天主的人得到成全；

text_en: Otherwise, would they not have ceased being offered, since the worshipers, cleansed once for all, would no longer have any consciousness of sin?
text_cn: 因为，如果那些行敬礼的人，一次而为永远洁净了，良心不再觉得有罪了，祭献岂不就要停止吗？

text_en: But in these sacrifices there is a reminder of sin year after year.
text_cn: 可是，正因这祭献才使人每年想起罪过来，

text_en: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
text_cn: 因为公牛和公山羊的血断不能除免罪过。

text_en: Consequently, when Christ came into the world, he said, “Sacrifices and offerings you have not desired, but a body you have prepared for me;
text_cn: 为此，基督一进入世界便说：“牺牲与素祭，已非你所要，却给我预备了一个身体；

text_en: in burnt offerings and sin offerings you have taken no pleasure.
text_cn: 全燔祭和赎罪祭，已非你所喜，

text_en: Then I said, ‘See, God, I have come to do your will, O God’ (in the scroll of the book it is written of me). ”
text_cn: 于是我说：看，我已来到！关于我，书卷上已有记载：天主！我来为承行你的旨意。”

text_en: When he said above, “You have neither desired nor taken pleasure in sacrifices and offerings and burnt offerings and sin offerings” (these are offered according to the law),
text_cn: 前边说：“祭物和素祭，全燔祭和赎罪祭，已非你所要，已非你所喜；”这一切都是按照法律所奉献的；

text_en: then he added, “See, I have come to do your will. ” He abolishes the first in order to establish the second.
text_cn: 后边他说：“看，我已来到，为承行你的旨意；”由此可见，他废除了那先前的，为要成立那以后的。

text_en: And it is by God’s will that we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
text_cn: 我们就是因这旨意，藉耶稣基督的身体，一次而为永远的祭献，得到了圣化。

text_en: And every priest stands day after day at his service, offering again and again the same sacrifices that can never take away sins.
text_cn: 况且，每一位司祭，都是天天侍立着执行敬礼，并屡次奉献总不能除去罪恶的同样牺牲；

text_en: But when Christ had offered for all time a single sacrifice for sins, “he sat down at the right hand of God, ”
text_cn: 但是基督只奉献了一次赎罪的牺牲，以后便永远坐在天主右边，

text_en: and since then has been waiting “until his enemies would be made a footstool for his feet. ”
text_cn: 从今以后，只等待将他的仇人变作他脚下的踏板。

text_en: For by a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are sanctified.
text_cn: 因为他只藉一次奉献，就永远使被圣化的人得以成全。

text_en: And the Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
text_cn: 圣神也给我们作证，因为他说过，

text_en: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord: I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds, ”
text_cn: “这是我在那些时日后，与他们订立的盟约──上主说──我要将我的法律放在他们的心中，写在他们的明悟中”这话以后，

text_en: he also adds, “I will remember their sins and their lawless deeds no more. ”
text_cn: 又说：“他们的罪过和他们的邪恶，我总不再追念。”

text_en: Where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer any offering for sin.
text_cn: 若这些罪已经赦了，也就用不着赎罪的祭献了。

text_en: Therefore, my friends, since we have confidence to enter the sanctuary by the blood of Jesus,
text_cn: 所以，弟兄们！我们既然怀着大胆的信心，靠着耶稣的宝血得以进入圣殿，

text_en: by the new and living way that he opened for us through the curtain (that is, through his flesh),
text_cn: 即进入由他给我们开创的一条又新又活，通过帐幔，即他肉身的道路；

text_en: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
text_cn: 而且我们既然又有一位掌管天主家庭的伟大司祭，

text_en: let us approach with a true heart in full assurance of faith, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
text_cn: 我们就应在洗净心灵，脱离邪僻的良心，和用净水洗涤身体以后，怀着真诚的心，以完备的信德去接近天主；

text_en: Let us hold fast to the confession of our hope without wavering, for he who has promised is faithful.
text_cn: 也应坚持所明认的望德，毫不动摇，因为应许的那位是忠信的；

text_en: And let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good deeds,
text_cn: 也应该彼此关怀，激发爱德，勉励行善，

text_en: not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
text_cn: 决不离弃我们的集会，就像一些人所习惯行的；反而应彼此劝勉；你们见那日子越近，就越该如此。

text_en: For if we willfully persist in sin after having received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
text_cn: 因为如果我们认识真理之后，还故意犯背信的罪，就再没有另一个赎罪祭了，

text_en: but a fearful prospect of judgment, and a fury of fire that will consume the adversaries.
text_cn: 只有一种等待审判的怕情，和势将吞灭叛逆者的烈火。

text_en: Anyone who has violated the law of Moses dies without mercy “on the testimony of two or three witnesses. ”
text_cn: 谁若废弃梅瑟法律，只要有两三个证人，他就该死，必不得怜恤；

text_en: How much worse punishment do you think will be deserved by those who have spurned the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant by which they were sanctified, and outraged the Spirit of grace?
text_cn: 那么，你们想一想：那践踏了天主子，拿自己藉以成圣的盟约的血当作了俗物，而又轻慢了赐恩宠的圣神的人，应当受怎样更厉害的惩罚啊！

text_en: For we know the one who said, “Vengeance is mine, I will repay. ” And again, “The Lord will judge his people. ”
text_cn: 因为我们知道谁曾说过：“复仇在乎我，我必要报复；”又说：“上主必要审判自己的百姓。”

text_en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
text_cn: 落在永生的天主手中，真是可怕！

text_en: But recall those earlier days when, after you had been enlightened, you endured a hard struggle with sufferings,
text_cn: 请你们回想回想先前的时日，那时你们才蒙光照，就忍受了苦难的严厉打击：

text_en: sometimes being publicly exposed to abuse and persecution, and sometimes being partners with those so treated.
text_cn: 一方面，你们当众受嗤笑、凌辱和磨难，另一方面，你们与这样受苦的人作了同伴。

text_en: For you had compassion for those who were in prison, and you cheerfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you yourselves possessed something better and more lasting.
text_cn: 的确，你们同情了监禁的人，又欣然忍受了你们的财物被抢掠，因为你们知道：你们已获有更高贵且常存的产业，

text_en: Do not, therefore, abandon that confidence of yours; it brings a great reward.
text_cn: 所以千万不要丧失那使你们可得大赏报的勇敢信心。

text_en: For you need endurance, so that when you have done the will of God, you may receive what was promised.
text_cn: 原来你们所需要的就是坚忍，为使你们承行天主的旨意，而获得那所应许的。

text_en: For yet “in a very little while, the one who is coming will come and will not delay;
text_cn: “因为还有很短的一会儿，要来的那一位，就要来到，决不迟缓。

text_en: but my righteous one will live by faith. My soul takes no pleasure in anyone who shrinks back. ”
text_cn: 我的义人靠信德而生活，假使他退缩，他必不会中悦我心。”

text_en: But we are not among those who shrink back and so are lost, but among those who have faith and so are saved.
text_cn: 我们并不是那般退缩以致丧亡的人，而是有信德得以保全灵魂的人。
